text:
deploy-bot: rollout start rl-2024-11-routegate v=release-3.4.1 -> green. Traffic policy: adaptive holdback=10% initial, ramp +5%/min per region. Auto-holdback thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms OR error_rate > 0.8% for 2 consecutive mins triggers hold/rollback. Change window 10:15-12:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/release/rl-2024-11-routegate

maria: @ops team watching EU first. I'll pin session-stickiness for EU to v=3.4.1 to limit cross-region flaps.

alex: request: cap us-west to 30% for first 10m - older NICs there saw jitter on previous kernel. Prefer manual ramp there.

sam: quick smoke checks ready: curl http://router-proxy/health -> expect 200 + header x-route:green. Will kick off loadgen at +3m.

jin: @ops-bot can you create a temporary route-gate entry scoped to eu and us-west so we can stage?

ops-bot: route-gate created RG-78 for rl-2024-11-routegate. Regions: eu*, us-west. Initial weights: green=10%, blue=90%. Warming started. Approvals required: @sre-lead for full regional ramp.

maria: noticing p95 up ~70ms in eu-west-1 at +2m. Holding at 10% while I tail logs.

sre-lead: rule: if p95 > 250ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR errors > 1% for 2m, initiate rollback. Rollback steps pinned in playbook, also require @sre-lead ack to shift full region back.

alex: updated rollback checklist: 1) /router set-version --pin=3.3.9 2) lbctl shift --to=blue --id=RG-78 3) drain new-route pods gracefully 4) notify customers via #incidents if >5m impact.

sam: quick question: if we execute lbctl shift, do we need an exp backoff? I'd rather use a 30s fade to avoid TCP resets.

ops-bot: lbctl supports --fade=30s. Shift command requires one approval from @sre-lead within 5m or it will auto-hold (no full rollback).

maria: ack. I'm watching logs and traces (trace id sample: 8a5c). Will report back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout update at +5m: ramped eu -> 30%. Metrics: p50=41ms, p95=178ms, errors=0.12%. No backend 5xx seen.

maria: p95 trending down to 160ms, continuing ramp to 60% over next 6m.

alex: pinned router.routeVersion=3.4.1 in gateway config until 11:00 UTC to avoid mid-ramp swaps.

sam: running simulated user flows against green at 50rps, attaching snippet:

```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -H 'x-route-preference: green' https://api.redwood/complete > /dev/null; done
```

jin: logs show a small surge of reconnects in us-west-2 at +8m, but not yet hitting threshold. Recommend hold there at 30% and let eu finish.

sre-lead: if us-west-2 crosses thresholds, we will hold region and not propagate to other regions. Also, keep release pinned on the router until +30m after full ramp.

maria: confirmed - holding us-west at 30%. Continuing eu ramp to 100% if stable.

ops-bot: note: manual override prepared: /lb shift --to=blue --id=RG-78 --fade=30s (requires @sre-lead approve). Stored in ops actions.

sre-lead: thanks team. If anything degrades beyond thresholds, call the rollback playbook and I'll approve the shift. Otherwise proceed with scheduled ramp cadence and update release notes with the kernel compatibility note for older NICs.

maria: will add release note bullet: "Pinned router kernel variant for us-west older NIC compatibility; manual cap applied during ramp."

sam: standing by on-call. :phone:

deploy-bot: final note: rollout id=rl-2024-11-routegate now at 60% global, EU=100%, US-west=30%, APAC=10%. Next update expected +10m.
